description: Horizontal bars ranking device types by users, each in its own color.
overview: A `BarChart` with `layout="vertical"`, so categories run down a `YAxis` and bars extend to the right, which leaves room for longer names. Each bar gets its color from `chartConfig` through a `Cell`, and the axis labels come from the same config.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your categories and values, and add a matching entry with a label and color to `chartConfig` for each category. The component takes no props.
